title: blockchainian plugin config
description: Shared per-user config at ~/.config/blockchainian/claude.json, keyed by skill name. Only keys a skill actually uses are defined.

namecheap.description: Namecheap official API credentials for domains.check. The calling IP must be whitelisted in the Namecheap API Access page.

apiUser.description: Namecheap account username (used for both ApiUser and UserName).

apiKey.description: Namecheap API key from Profile > Tools > API Access.
